title: Reviews clarify the full combat, mission and exploration loop
text: Completed reviews and PlayStation's full-game hands-on confirm a roughly 25–35-hour main story, optional Resonants, traversal-focused Jesse Quests, post-story free roam and a combat loop built around Falter, executions and Dominance. Opinions differ sharply on combat balance and late-game enemy durability, so exact builds and routes still require versioned testing.

title: Launch trailer shows Dylan and the Aberrant ahead of release
text: Remedy's launch trailer puts Dylan, warped Manhattan and several Aberrant Forms in view. It confirms the September 24 digital launch but does not reveal a complete boss roster or final combat balance.

title: Extended developer documentary explores the world and bosses
text: The PC Gaming Show documentary discusses the design of Manhattan and its otherworldly threats. Watch it for creative context, not a route, full boss list or verified encounter strategy.

title: PS5 and PS5 Pro performance modes detailed
text: Remedy outlined 60fps and 30fps modes on PS5, three modes on PS5 Pro, DualSense feedback, 3D Audio and an estimated 25–35-hour main story.

title: Meet the Cast reveals more returning Bureau characters
text: The diary confirms actors for Dylan, Jesse and Zoe, alongside Darling, Emily Pope, Simon Arish and Frederick Langston. The character guide labels these returning-cast spoilers.

title: Expanded Assist Mode detailed
text: Individual controls include enemy aggression, dodge timing, projectile speed, damage, falter, power recovery, melee magnetizing, immortality, and one-hit options. Assist Mode does not gate trophies or achievements.

title: Final PC requirements published
text: Remedy confirmed six performance tiers, 16 GB RAM across the board, Windows 10/11 64-bit, 120 GB SSD storage, DLSS 4.5, FSR 4.1, ray tracing, path tracing, HDR, and ultra-wide support.

title: Altered State trailer released
text: The Gamescom trailer offered another look at Dylan, the Aberrant, warped Manhattan, and the forces reshaping reality before launch.

title: Zone XP and changing world encounters explained
text: IGN's developer feature connects zone activities, local improvements, Talent points and the consequences of defeating Resonants.

title: Game goes gold; physical date moves
text: The digital release remains September 24. Physical PS5 and Xbox Series X|S editions now release October 15.

title: Central Resonant boss fight shown
text: The publisher identifies the Central Resonant and its lava and magma hazards. Exact launch rewards and damage resistances are not established by the preview description.

title: Metro Fault and the Reach traversal reward
text: The published mission preview introduces a dungeon-like Fault with train hazards, Mold enemies and a grappling-style movement unlock.

title: Worldwide digital release set for September 24
text: Remedy confirmed the date for PS5, Xbox Series X|S, Steam, and Epic Games Store, with GeForce NOW at launch and Mac following later in 2026.

title: New Game+ systems explained
text: Remedy detailed carry-over progression, additional talent nodes, expanded ability combinations, a fourth Artifact slot, and a more dangerous returning world.

title: Combat and buildcrafting deep dive
text: Remedy explained the melee-to-ability resource loop, executions, The Gap, Weapon Forms, Combat Abilities, Talents, Artifacts, World Quests, Zoe De Vera, and branching Resonant rewards.

title: First full gameplay details published
text: The PS5 Pro footage introduced the West Incursion Zone, large handcrafted Manhattan zones, optional discoveries, hidden encounters, and Gravity Anomalies.

title: CONTROL Resonant officially revealed
text: Remedy announced Dylan Faden as protagonist, the Aberrant as his shapeshifting melee weapon, the Manhattan setting, and the game's open-ended action-RPG direction.
